messages:
lucy: Heads up — Milestone Health wants a compact compliance bundle for procurement: SOC2 artifacts, a pen-test letter (vendor-signed preferred), and staging creds for a weekend POC. Can we deliver by next Friday?
mike (Solutions): We can provide scoped staging creds (API key with ip allowlist + rate limits) and a runbook. For full throughput testing they'd need a short dedicated slot.
tara (Security): Vendor pen-test letter will take vendor time (~10-14 business days) and a fee. We can instead provide: redacted SOC2, internal vuln scan snapshot, and a Redwood-signed attestation quickly. That tends to satisfy many auditors.
jamal (Sales Ops): Pricing implications: dedicated POC hosts need reserved pricing. Recommend a 5-day reserved flat fee — cheaper than ad-hoc billing headaches. Any internal POC discount?
lucy: Auditor said vendor-signed is ideal but will accept Redwood attestation if we can show external testing within 12 months. Need anything else from Legal?
tara (Security): If we request the vendor to issue a one-off letter, Legal will need to sign off on the request and budget. I'll ask vendor for expedited ETA but can't promise. Meanwhile I'll prepare the attestation + SOC2 redacted + vuln snapshot this week.
mike (Solutions): I'll make the scoped API key with default TTL 72h; can extend to 168h for the weekend. I'll add ip allowlist and sample cURL snippet in the runbook.
compliance-bot: [automated] Request created CR-2026-789. Assignee: tara. SLA: 10 business days.
jamal (Sales Ops): For quote, propose two options: (1) scoped API key + attestation (no charge), (2) 5-day dedicated POC (flat $2,200). Include TTL and termination language.
lucy: Offer option 1 first to hit procurement deadline; add option 2 as an add-on. Jamal, include that in the quote.
tara (Security): Uploading attestation draft and redacted SOC2 zip to secure share. Mike, please ensure any logs in vuln snapshot are redacted for PII.
mike (Solutions): Will redact and attach redaction checklist. I'll produce runbook and creds today.
compliance-bot: CR-2026-789 updated: attestation uploaded by tara.
lucy: Perfect. I'll tell the customer we can deliver attestation + SOC2 + scoped creds today and give vendor pen-test ETA tomorrow. Keep updates short here.
(END)
